mission.name: Blood and Thunder (Orc 2/3)
mission.briefing: A human legion drills beyond the water. Train your warband and meet them in the field — they will not wait forever.

ops.text: Shaman: the humans sharpen their swords, warchief. Sharpen yours first.
Your keep has fallen. The campaign is lost.
The enemy is wiped from these lands. Victory!
